apps.name: WQ Files
apps.subtitle: File manager for iOS 26 and 27 (worse_query)
apps.localizedDescription:
File browser, app data manager and cache cleaner for iOS 26 and 27, built on the worse_query sandbox technique. No jailbreak and no kernel exploit.

• Browse every app's data container, app groups, extension and daemon containers
• Plist editor and hex viewer/editor; edits are backed up first
• Select, move across apps, compress and extract ZIPs; import files and whole folders
• Syntax highlighting, SQLite viewer and media player
• Back up, restore and clear app data; AirDrop backups as ZIP
• Cache cleaner

iOS 26 and 27 (tested on 26.7.1, 27.0.1 and 27.2.1; on iOS 26, System Data and System Groups are not available). Needs a signer that keeps the App Group entitlement (AltStore, SideStore or Impactor; not Sideloadly).

versions.localizedDescription: New: iOS 27.3 beta, Turkish, flags in the language list, Replace All when importing several files, Rename in Select, restore edited backups. Many safety fixes from a code review (folder delete, SQLite backups, ZIP, hex and plist editors, media).

New: delete folders with everything in them (backed up, restorable), Polish and Russian, filters in App Data, version in the device strip, Reset Access Cache. Fixed: backups with sockets, Share as ZIP of app folders, app names.
New: startup check (stops with what failed instead of empty lists when access breaks), Recently Deleted under Backups. Cache Cleaner progress bar.
New: edit SQLite databases (Edit, then Save writes back with a backup and integrity check). Korean translation. Fixed: Arabic corrections, empty app lists after an iOS update.

Now in Simplified Chinese, Arabic, German, Italian and Spanish, with a Language setting. New: Import as Backup, Keep Data Before Restore, media streams instead of copying, offloaded apps and App Bundles (iOS 27). Apps and the Cache Cleaner reopen instantly.

Select, move across apps, compress and extract ZIPs; import several files or whole folders. New: syntax highlighting, media player, Apps filter, bundle IDs and Copy Bundle ID, restore from App Backups, Allow Deleting and Show Item Counts settings. Fixed: iOS 26.5 app list, deleting locked files. Signing: use AltStore, SideStore or Impactor (Sideloadly drops the App Group).

Apps show up in seconds on every iOS version (no more long first scan); full scans only when needed and after you agree. New: sorting, A–Z sidebar, read-only SQLite viewer, swipe to delete, signing check at launch. Preliminary iOS 26 support.
iOS 27.2: app names are back. iOS 26 (26.0 – 26.7.2) is supported. Faster scans that are remembered, swipe to delete in the file browser, and a more detailed Log.
Cooler, faster scans (one shared pass, fewer cores); manage and delete backups, stop a cache clean, cancel ZIP exports; checked backups and restores; signing help in the README. Requires iOS 27.
AltStore/SideStore source; safer saves and restores (rollback, interrupted-restore recovery, no overwriting changed files); Log shows version, device and iOS.
Plist editor, hex viewer/editor, Open As, search bar, Home button, readable paths.
Safer backups and restores; large files are streamed.
Fixed: apps you installed were missing.
